metadata.description: Plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, and Grok Bot: agent workflows, git automation, and developer tools.

plugins.name: team-agents
plugins.description: Leader, senior, and junior engineer agents plus React, TypeScript, backend, and quality skills for parallel work.

plugins.name: commit
plugins.description: Semantic commits, with optional push or a PR from templates.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: Distinctive, production-grade frontend design that avoids generic AI aesthetics.

plugins.name: interview
plugins.description: Interview the user to clarify requirements, then write a spec.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Configurable status bar showing context usage, API rate limits, git branch, and active tools

plugins.name: orchestration
plugins.description: Orchestrator skill for managing parallel agent workstreams

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: Drive PRs to merge-ready with gh: fix CI and review-bot feedback, plus bulk merge, close, and label.

plugins.name: fix
plugins.description: Fix failing tests, lint, and CI, then commit and push or open or update a PR.

plugins.name: clickhouse
plugins.description: ClickHouse review rules for schemas, queries, and inserts, with references for debugging and monitoring queries.

plugins.name: prompt-engineering
plugins.description: Prompting guidance and per-model deltas for Claude, Gemini, and Grok.

plugins.name: chmonitor
plugins.description: Read-only ClickHouse monitoring and advice through the chmonitor MCP server, with pointers to its docs and codebase.

plugins.name: unsloth-training
plugins.description: Fine-tune LLMs with Unsloth using GRPO or SFT: rewards, datasets, FP8, vision, MLX, export, mobile.

plugins.name: good-html
plugins.description: Dense, interactive, self-contained HTML artifacts and reviews.

plugins.name: anyrouter
plugins.description: Wire AnyRouter, an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway, into projects and agents, with migration help and an MCP server.

plugins.name: sag-notify
plugins.description: Spoken voice notifications via sag (ElevenLabs TTS): skill-driven, Claude calls sag directly to speak a short alert just before it asks you something and a one-line summary when work finishes, naming the project. Configurable voice and language.

plugins.name: build-macos-apps
plugins.description: Build, debug, instrument, and implement macOS apps with SwiftUI and AppKit guidance, codesigning, packaging, and telemetry workflows.

plugins.name: build-ios-apps
plugins.description: Build, debug, and profile iOS apps with SwiftUI, Simulator, App Intents, and on-device AI.

plugins.name: agent-loop
plugins.description: Unattended repo maintenance that triages issues and PRs, dispatches fixes to parallel subagents, and reports results each scheduled cycle.

plugins.name: kb
plugins.description: Knowledge base maintenance skills. Initialize a shared-brain kb, then consolidate, dedupe, prune, refresh, and forget notes in a markdown KB.

plugins.name: okf
plugins.description: Open Knowledge Format (OKF) tooling. Author, initialize, validate, render, and refactor knowledge into vendor-neutral OKF v0.1 bundles: markdown files with YAML frontmatter.

plugins.name: command-code
plugins.description: Dispatch the Command Code CLI (`cmd`) as headless sub-agents across isolated git worktrees.
